title: Arknights TV Animation [PRELUDE TO DAWN] Official Trailer 4 Giveaway Event
lines: Arknights TV Animation [PRELUDE TO DAWN] Official Trailer 4 Giveaway Event
To celebrate the coming premiere of Arknights TV Animation [PRELUDE TO DAWN], Doctors can participate in the giveaway event by reposting the Official Trailer 4 post on Twitter/Facebook.
50 Google Play/App Store Gift Cards ($30 each) will be randomly given to Doctors who repost, and 25 Doctors each on Twitter and Facebook.
Gift Cards will be sent in November 2022.
We look forward to your participation!
